description: Maps each intentionally-invalid Common envelope example to the specific constraint it must violate. The reference validator test suite (src/modules/standards/common/envelope.test.ts) asserts every file fails, and fails FOR THE STATED REASON — so a schema change that accidentally stops enforcing a rule is caught. 'layer' is 'schema' when the raw JSON Schema rejects it, or 'semantic' when the document is schema-valid but violates a prose rule the reference validator enforces.

cases.reason: specVersion '1.0' is not full SemVer major.minor.patch.
id is not an absolute URI.
A non-standard top-level member is present; extra data must go under extensions.
provenance[0].sourceType is outside the controlled vocabulary.
An extension key is not namespaced (no '.' or ':' separator).
license carries neither spdxId nor name.
Document is schema-valid but updatedAt precedes createdAt.
attribution is present but empty, which credits nobody; the member must be omitted instead.
